Dear Miss Yonge,
We shall soon be out with the [Cameos](/book/73).

It has occurred to me that we ought to put the period over which the narratives extend, on the title page.

Will you kindly add it to the enclosed proof.

Yours very truly
[A.

Macmillan](/person/939)
